connector.name: HPP x402 MCP Bridge
connector.registryDescription: MCP bridge for autonomous x402 payments in HPP USDC.e - discover and pay for services per call.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package x402-mcp-bridge. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hpp-io account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: DELEGATE_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Delegate EOA private key used to sign payments. Auto-created in the OS keychain if unset.

env.name: HPP_NETWORK
env.description: Target network: eip155:181228 (HPP Sepolia, default) or eip155:190415 (HPP Mainnet).

env.name: RESOURCE_SERVER_URL
env.description: Optional upstream MCP server to proxy. Omit to expose only the local tools.

env.name: SAFE_ADDRESS
env.description: Safe address for governance (Safe) mode. Set together with ALLOWANCE_MODULE_ADDRESS.

env.name: ALLOWANCE_MODULE_ADDRESS
env.description: Safe AllowanceModule address for governance (Safe) mode. Set together with SAFE_ADDRESS.
